html:
SMTO-GWT-0015 — Too many attempts to link with this Gateway

GUID: e9775ecd-c4af-48d8-bf98-5e88c49547c7
Slug: gateway-pairing-rate-limited
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gateway

What happened

  • The Gateway allows only 30 attempts per minute to link a new SMTO. That limit was reached, so it ignored this attempt and changed nothing.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait at least one minute without trying again. The Gateway counts attempts over the last minute, so waiting resets the limit.
  2. Make sure only one SMTO is trying to use this Gateway. Remove it from the Gateways list of any other SMTO, or ask whoever runs that SMTO to. Another SMTO retrying in the background can use up the limit.
  3. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection on that Gateway's row once. A single check is enough for SMTO to link to the Gateway.

What success looks like

  • The Gateway's row shows Connected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages that Gateway, so they can find what keeps trying to link. Don't keep clicking Check connection while the limit is active.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gateway's pairing endpoint refused the attempt because it had already admitted thirty pairing attempts within its sixty-second window.

What this means

  • The pairing endpoint recorded thirty attempts within its sixty-second admission window and refused another attempt. Use the retained operation phase and identity to determine effects; this explanation does not authorize retries or change pairing, target selection or execution ownership.

Why this can happen

  • The pairing endpoint recorded thirty attempts within its sixty-second admission window and refused another attempt.

How to diagnose it

  • Check for overlapping pairing clients or a reconnect loop and the timing of the last attempts.

How to fix it

  • ControllerAuthMiddleware admits at most 30 GET /pair/challenge or POST /pair requests per 60 seconds per Gateway process. Find and stop the client repeatedly attempting to pair (another Server, a script or a reconnect loop, visible in the Gateway log), wait 60 seconds, then make one deliberate attempt.
  • Wait for the pairing rate-limit period to end before a new deliberate pairing attempt.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • One deliberate pairing attempt is admitted after the rate-limit window expires.

What not to do

  • Do not use a rapid retry loop or replay an uncertain mutation while waiting for the stated condition.

Technical notes

  • Use the retained operation phase and identity to determine effects; this explanation does not authorize retries or change pairing, target selection or execution ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
